fields.doc:
NRM Loop Flag controls monitoring behaviour: 
0 = Individual NRM monitoring suppressed (loop operational with aggregate IRSR >= 0)
1 = Individual NRM monitoring active (applies to: loop not operational, aggregate loop IRSR < 0, or non-loop interconnection)
This flag is evaluated and set for ALL interconnections in each dispatch interval
fields.name: NRM_LOOP_FLAG
